No. The evidence does not confirm that the forest has remained intact since 2020.

The JRC dataset identifies 285.6 hectares—about 91.8% of the asset—as forest in 2020. Annual Hansen data are available through 2025, but the supplied output does not report whether any forest loss occurred after 2020. It also provides no evidence for 2026.

A review of the post-2020 loss results is needed to assess whether the forest remained intact through 2025.
